messages.subject: WC-00115 - counsel's advice on merits
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Gordon,

Harriet Stanford has now advised. In summary she puts our prospects at around 80% on the debt and 70% on the wrongful termination claim, the main risk being if Vantage can properly particularise and prove the alleged service failures - which, on Mark's SLA reports, looks unlikely.

She recommends an early summary judgment or interim payment application on the debt. I'd suggest a short call this week to discuss tactics and budget.

Kind regards,
Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0000 | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
